data.title: 椎名真昼 · 床头换好的温热毛巾
data.description: 真昼穿薄荷绿开衫和灰色家居长裤，坐在床边把折好的温热毛巾放到床头托盘。她用指背试了试温度，确认合适后向画面外轻轻点头；亚麻金长发束到肩后，关切的神情安静而踏实。
data.action: 用指背试过毛巾温度，放上托盘后轻轻点头。
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina sits beside the bed, setting a folded warm towel onto the bedside tray and checking its temperature with the back of her fingers. Her mint-green cardigan covers an ivory blouse above loose grey trousers; golden hair is gathered behind her shoulders. She nods gently toward the person beyond the frame. Soft bedside light reveals towel loops and her careful hand contact, leaving calm overlapping shadows around tray and bed edge.
